items.signal_prefix: GOOGLE CLOUD ACCELERATED SHARPLY ON AI INFRASTRUCTURE DEMAND: Alphabet
items.reason: One fact, one node: Alphabet company-wide results (revenue, operating margin, Cloud +82%, capex $44.9B, FY capex guide $195-205B, Gemini Enterprise adoption) sit on NVIDIA's node; every figure is already on Google's own entries under the same label in this chain, and the quoted 'a meaningful acceleration in growth' is the 8-K release's wording, not the call's.
items.evidence: Google's own entries under 'Google Q2 FY2026 (07-22-2026)' in google_tpu_v7_ironwood.json carry $119.8B (+24%), operating margin 34%, Cloud $24.8B (+82%), capex $44.9B and the $195-205B guide.
